product_fixes: Settings integration: Android IME synchronization, accessibility and reduced motion, GLES program-cache validation, obscured-gesture cancellation and scroll-position observation.
Contained-app isolation and secret-input restrictions come from the pinned upstream runtime; the Settings overlay preserves those gates.

QR scanner API (OctoSense-org/makepad#31, merged into makepad main at b03656ee but not in runtime cd812acd; platform/ and tools/ only, its qr_scan example is left out): Cx::show_qr_scanner opens the Android Camera2 scanner and answers exactly once with NativeQrScanned { json } or NativeQrCancelled { reason }; back, pause and a refused CAMERA permission cancel it.
